title: Game disassembly and reconstruction discovery
summary: Review 32 game reversing and reconstruction projects across NES, DOS and ZX Spectrum.
notes: Personally compared repository URLs with the current catalogue and reviewed primary README documentation. No independent build, execution, gameplay or binary comparison.
